messages.subject: Calderdale House — heads of terms (subject to contract)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Frances,

For your records, the agreed heads of terms record a price of £8,300,000, a 10% deposit on exchange, sale subject to the three existing leases (aggregate rent £601,500 p.a.), a six-week exclusivity period and a TOGC VAT treatment. Target exchange 7 March, completion 28 March.

We will treat the price as the starting position; Pemberton Rowe have hinted the seller may push for more given recent comparables, so let's see what comes back on the contract.

Best,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
